FEATURED RESEARCH POSTER · LOS ALAMOS · 2026

From a charge-conserving solver to GPU-accelerated Shadow MD.

My LANL Student Symposium poster highlights an early milestone: a charge-conserving projected solver compared against GMRES. That work laid the foundation for ALAMOS and later 104,640-atom simulations.

Jos Thomas · Anders M. N. Niklasson · Christian Negre · Anthony P. Baldo · LA-UR-26-26347

MEET APPLE / CONNECT & CHAT · CHICAGO

Invited to Meet Apple — Connect & Chat.

I was grateful to be invited to Meet Apple — Connect & Chat, a private, invitation-only event hosted by Apple in Chicago.

I really enjoyed speaking one-on-one with some of Apple's software engineers, seeing technical demos, and hearing firsthand about the challenges they tackle and how they approach building software.

Thanks to the Apple team for having me. I especially appreciated how approachable everyone was and how open they were about sharing their experiences.
